steps.input:
cd "<sandbox>" && python3 -I -c "
import gzip,sys
rows=[]
with gzip.open('data/spike_H0.report.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        if len(p)<6: continue
        name=p[5]
        if 'Mycobacter' in name or p[3]=='S' and 'Mycobacter' in name:
            rows.append((p[0],p[1],p[2],p[3],p[4],name))
for r in rows: print('\t'.join(r))
print('---total lines', sum(1 for _ in gzip.open('data/spike_H0.report.gz','rt')))
" ; ls data
